publisher.role: dataset project / manager as described by the public dataset materials

known_gaps: No public contributor/provider roster or rights-grant documents were located for the NRG-CP files.
No public per-file manifest was located that maps each MIDI file to a source rights record.

The README describes the MIDI corpus as generated from a symbolic chord-progression database and custom rhythm-generation code, while its license paragraph uses the broader term recordings; the upstream source database and transformation rights are not documented.
The public commercial-use and AI-training statements are publisher assertions and do not independently prove the underlying rights chain for every contained file.
required_for_approval: Identify the source rights holder(s) or a documented intermediary with authority for the underlying symbolic material.
Obtain documentary evidence that the identified rights holder(s) granted the required commercial training and redistribution rights to WaivOps/Patchbanks.
Obtain an authoritative file manifest or equivalent source mapping showing coverage of all 30,943 contained MIDI files.
Preserve immutable revision identifiers and hashes for the authority evidence used in the production audit.
